why: Could not refute on any of the three axes. (1) DOC VERBATIM: curl -sL of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/troubleshoot-install.md line 654 carries the quoted sentence character-for-character, prefixed by the MDX marker {/* min-version: 2.1.219 */}. Read whole: the remainder of the line is 'A path that doesn't exist gets the same fallback and warning. Before v2.1.219, Claude Code used any existing file as the shell without checking its name, and exited at startup with `Claude Code was unable to find CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH path` when the path didn't exist.' Nothing there reverses the conclusion; it only version-gates the four-name enum to >= 2.1.219. (2) CITED CODE: packages/server-core/src/services/git-bash.ts:8 is exactly /(?:^|[\\/])bash\.exe$/i and :18-19 returns {valid:false, error:'Path must point to bash.exe'}. Cited consumer line numbers are exact: packages/server-core/src/handlers/rpc/system.ts:216, :224, :238 (auto-detect assignments) and :272 (SET_PATH assignment), with :219 clearGitBashPath() on a persisted path that fails revalidation. (3) LAYER UP / LAYER DOWN, and the CONSEQUENCE tested separately from the identifier. Layer down gave a positive control for the claim's load-bearing half ('which the SDK we spawn would accept'): the bundled consumer, node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.183, bridge.mjs, resolves the variable as `if(process.env.CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH){if(existsSync(...))return process.env.CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH; console.error(`Claude Code was unable to find CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH path "..."`),process.exit(1)}` — no filename test whatsoever, so it would accept C:\Program Files\Git\bin\sh.exe (and bash, and sh). Our gate is therefore narrower than the documented enum AND narrower than the consumer we actually ship. Layer up: the narrowing is reached on three independent paths, not one — the onboarding SET_PATH handler (system.ts:266), the RPC auto-detect (system.ts:213-219), and the startup revalidation at apps/electron/src/main/index.ts:596-604, which on failure calls clearGitBashPath() and deletes the env var; the same code is duplicated at apps/electron/src/main/handlers/system.ts:137-196. The Browse dialog (system.ts:250-263) filters to extensions:['exe'], so the extension-less `bash`/`sh` names cannot even be selected, and the auto-probe list is four hardcoded bash.exe paths. Sibling-subsystem check: rg over the repo finds no second, broader Git Bash validator; isGitBashExecutablePath/validateGitBashPath/isUsableGitBashPath have exactly these consumers plus one test. The narrowing is locked in by apps/electron/src/main/__tests__/git-bash.test.ts:21, which asserts isGitBashExecutablePath('/tmp/git/bin/sh.exe') === false. Not an owner decision: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3's nine dated decisions are SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, and listSessionSummaries/listSessions — none is this, and grep for bash.exe/GIT_BASH across the parity audit and the deviation register returns no recorded ruling. Not a rebrand or dropped-subscription product difference either: CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH is written verbatim under Claude's own name for Claude's own subprocess, and the Git Bash onboarding step is not provider-gated. Only bound on the finding: practical exposure is limited to Windows hosts whose Git install is being pointed at by hand, and NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE is off by default (though the SDK JS core always ships).
correctedState: Confirmed as filed, with one correction to the framing of the consumer. git-bash.ts:8 anchors on bash.exe alone and :19 hard-errors 'Path must point to bash.exe'; a Git for Windows sh.exe is refused by onboarding (system.ts:266-272), by auto-detect (system.ts:213-239) and by the startup revalidation (apps/electron/src/main/index.ts:596-604), which additionally clears the persisted path. The refusal is narrower than Claude's documented four-name enum {bash.exe, sh.exe, bash, sh} — but note that enum is min-version 2.1.219, and the consumer this fork actually spawns, @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.183 bridge.mjs, still implements the pre-2.1.219 rule: it applies NO filename check (existsSync only) and process.exit(1)s with 'Claude Code was unable to find CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH path' on a missing path. So our validator is narrower than both the doc and the shipped SDK. Split the fix accordingly: the existence half of validateGitBashPath is protective — it prevents the shipped SDK's hard exit and should stay — while the name half should widen to the documented enum (basename in {bash.exe, sh.exe, bash, sh}, case-insensitive), together with the auto-probe list, the Browse dialog's exe-only filter (which blocks the extension-less names outright), the error string, and the assertion at apps/electron/src/main/__tests__/git-bash.test.ts:21. The duplicate handler at apps/electron/src/main/handlers/system.ts:137-196 must be changed in the same pass.
